Your credit card shows six TicketBox charges from May to September 2026 totalling $470.00 (Celtics $74.50, Lakers $68.00, Nuggets $92.00, Tyler, the Creator $72.00, Hamilton $78.50, Clippers $85.00), which I averaged over those five months.

The prices in TicketBox are higher than the card charges. Its history lists 25 tickets totalling $3,818, including the two upcoming ones (Blues at Sharks $74, Hamilton $267). For the same games and shows, TicketBox lists higher prices than the card shows (for example Hamilton $198 against $78.50 charged). Some purchases may have been split or paid another way. Separately, your checking account shows a $42.00 SplitPay "Concert tickets split" that isn't in the $179.80.

I only changed the "This month" column. The Avg/month column still says 85 for Entertainment.
